text_block_list.text:
At last, it's time for Oguri Cap's Debut 
Race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Is it finally starting? Strangely... I 
feel calm."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because you're here watching over 
me, just like everyone back home... I'll 
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"For everyone who supported me and sent me 
off... I will answer their feelings."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, let's run. So we can start from 
here.
